candidate: Replace private BTreeMap representation of small feature/default/query dictionaries with sorted Vec entries while preserving public behavior.
next_review_trigger: After the production collection refactor and its exact-case proof, return to the next Agones production feature and assess source-aware derive hygiene at the next public API/resource milestone.
rationale: The exact production query proof at unwind 64 is expanding standard-library B-tree node parent-link and comparison loops even though its fixture has only two features. The current diagnostic run is bounded to 240 seconds and will be retained regardless of outcome. Directly modeling a different map under cfg(kani) would not establish production semantics. A sorted Vec is an ordinary production representation for this small dictionary, preserving byte-sorted encoding, first query value, last duplicate default, atomic replacement, arbitrary names/bytes and unbounded accepted input sizes. It removes B-tree node machinery from both production and its model without reducing any source case, invariant, cover or declared bound.
roi: One local container change in features.rs replaces three private BTreeMap operations; no new public framework, macro or backend is introduced. Validate all existing query/configuration/process/source tests plus duplicate-default and map-order edge witnesses. The concrete payoff is completion of the already generated 17-assertion production proof and simpler storage plumbing for the fixed 15 production gates. If this does not address the observed B-tree expansion, stop representation work and schedule the remaining adequately bounded proof; never reduce proof obligations to obtain a pass.
